title: Network Collaboration: Data-driven reduction of illegal wildlife trade

context_sources.name: CITES
context_sources.role: Primary IWT trade data for 193 countries

context_sources.name: Center for Nature and Society, Peking University
context_sources.role: Survey data on public support for anti-IWT

tasks: Task 1: Select client via population competition model
Task 2: Verify project suitability, convince client with data
Task 3: Design 3-strategy framework for 5-year IWT reduction
Task 4: Implement strategies and measure effectiveness
Task 5: Calculate attainment probability and sensitivity

section_map.summary: Problem choice F, abstract with task-indexed results
CITES data from 193 countries, normalization, entropy
TSP+SA for publicity, hotspot network, monitoring systems
Memo to INO with 5-year plan table
Additional materials and AI use report

contributions.summary: Lotka-Volterra predator-prey model for conservation organization client selection.
BP neural network (R=0.966) for 5-year IWT volume prediction.
TSP+simulated annealing for optimal 166-country publicity route (1696 days).

dependency_graph.handoff: Client selection (INO) informs BP prediction target scope
IWT volume predictions justify project necessity and inform strategy design
Strategy results feed into attainment probability computation

assumptions.summary: Smallest IWT participants measured by country.
Collected data is precise and representative.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: CITES data from 193 countries for 36 years (1986-2021).

models.summary: LV: Lotka-Volterra population competition with AHP-weighted CAI scoring.
BP: Neural network prediction of IWT volumes.
TSP+SA: Optimal publicity route across 166 countries.

verification.summary: BP neural network R-values: training 0.997, verification 0.939, test 0.929.
Heat map comparison: 23.5% global IWT decrease after 5 years.

results_trace.summary: Client selection: INO scores 0.51, highest among GA(0.42)/INO(0.51)/PAP(0.37).
Biodiversity conservation level predicted to increase 21% in 5 years.
Optimal publicity route: 1696 days for full global cycle.
Global IWT decrease of 23.5% after 5-year implementation.

writing_logic.summary: Abstract uses task-indexed structure (For task1...For task5) with quantitative results per task.
Introduction uses economic-scale opener ($26.5B), literature review, bullet workflow.
Model sections use predator-prey ecological metaphor for organizational competition.
Strategy sections follow define-solve-result pattern with figure references.
Memo uses year-by-year table for each of three strategies.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Task-indexed structure with quantitative results per task signals comprehensive problem coverage.
TSP+SA for 166-country route optimization demonstrates algorithmic sophistication.
Probabilistic attainment model with sensitivity analysis shows risk awareness.

weaknesses.summary: Assumes stable social environment without sudden changes.
Not all countries in world included in data computation.
Predator-prey analogy for organizational competition is a strong simplification.
BP network architecture not specified (layers, neurons).

independent_extensions.summary: Replace LV with agent-based model for organizational dynamics.
Use genetic algorithm or ant colony optimization instead of SA for TSP.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Lotka-Volterra ecological metaphor for client evaluation.
TSP+SA optimization for global route planning.

unresolved_questions.question: What is the BP neural network architecture (number of layers and neurons)?
What SA cooling parameters were used?
